data.title: Speeding fine (Bußgeldbescheid) – €98.50, 1 point
data.summary: The Berlin police fine office (Bußgeldstelle) fined you €98.50 in total for driving 23 km/h over the limit on 12 November 2025. It was formally delivered on 11 December 2025 and you may object (Einspruch) within two weeks of delivery.
data.explanation: You are accused of speeding (93 km/h in a 70 km/h zone) on 12 November 2025. The fine is €70 plus €25 fees and €3.50 costs, and 1 point is entered in the driving-fitness register (Fahreignungsregister). You can pay or object (Einspruch). An objection must be filed in writing or recorded in person at the fine office within two weeks of delivery; the app shows the deadline. If you don't object, the decision becomes final and the total is due two weeks later. In court the judge is not bound by the fine amount. Consider legal advice if you plan to object.

items.title: Object to the fine (Einspruch)

date.text: binnen zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung

items.action: File an objection in writing or in person (zur Niederschrift) with the fine office if you disagree.
items.consequence: Without an objection the decision becomes final and the fine must be paid.
items.quote: Er muss binnen zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Polizei Berlin (Muster) – Bußgeldstelle eingelegt werden.

items.title: Pay the fine

date.text: zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist

items.action: Pay €98.50 to the fine office and state the file number (Aktenzeichen) OWi 5114/25-VK; due two weeks after the decision becomes final.
items.consequence: Unpaid fines may lead to reminders and enforcement.
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, fällig; geben Sie bei der Überweisung bitte das Aktenzeichen an.
